gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gantari: Wide-mouthed and swaggering, Cherry Swash takes the heading with heavy diagonals that match its verticals. Gantari follows in a wire-bent, friendly sans-serif, and its open curves give the loud top line some breathing room.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gayathri: Gayathri has open-ended curves and a faint letterpress-slug thickening that keeps it mild and approachable. Gayathri sits under Cherry Swash, whose wirelike strokes are uniform, so the heading looks drawn while the text looks pressed.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans: Horseshoe curves, big attitude. Google Sans keeps its strokes uniform with terminals pulled well back, a sans-serif that lets Cherry Swash do the shouting while the text stays friendly and modern.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans-flex: Cherry Swash opens each c wide like a horseshoe, and its diagonals carry as much weight as its verticals, which gives it a distinctive, commanding voice. Google Sans Flex cuts its stroke ends like a single ribbon, a modern sans with clean open gaps.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gothic-a1: Cherry Swash lands with stencil-cut letters of steady width and a horseshoe c, while Gothic A1 stays low-key beneath it. Strong contrast.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gotu: That horseshoe c, drawn with one constant drafting-pen nib width, gives Cherry Swash an outlined, commanding look over Gotu's moderate spread of heavy and light. Gotu's sturdy hairlines make a long page go down easily.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gowun-dodum: Cherry Swash arrives loud and distinctive, its horseshoe c wide open, with diagonals as heavy as the verticals. Gowun Dodum's smooth, tube-like lines make it feel gentle by comparison.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gruppo: Cherry Swash has no hairlines and no swells anywhere, just a wide horseshoe c and sturdy diagonals. Gruppo, a plain sans with curve endings that never crowd each other, keeps a long page of text light and unhurried.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gudea: Cherry Swash goes first, horseshoe c and all. Gudea's thread-thin curves and glass-clear gaps between terminal and stroke make the pair feel like a bold statement followed by a plain sans that stays friendly and modern.
